claim: Push, shove and similar verbs “allow a way object before a goal complement”, and the example is followed by “(cf. Ch. 8, §4.4)”.
evidence_summary: The way construction is in §4.3, p. 685, under its own heading: [23] We made our way to the station, Jill had to elbow her way to the exit. §4.4 (p. 689) is “Metaphorical extension of the locative categories to other domains”.
finding: Change §4.4 to §4.3. Like Ch. 4 p. 258 (CG-0170) and Ch. 8 p. 665 [1ix], this reference into Ch. 8, §4 points one place too high.
inference: Does the cited section treat the way construction?
